title: EDPB Updated Guidelines on Storage Limitation (2026 Revision)
change_summary: Prazo máximo estrito de retenção de logs e telemetria de tráfego reduzido de 10 para 5 anos. Exige anonimização ou expurgo obrigatório de IPs.

requirements.title: Storage Limitation Principle (Updated 2026)
requirements.description: Retention of user connection logs, telemetry, and IP traces must not exceed 5 years under any circumstances for EU residents.

requirements.title: Right to Erasure ('Right to be Forgotten')
requirements.description: Immediate erasure required upon subject request without undue delay.
